evals.prompt: $compare Build the Wax & Wane landing page with Qloo and without it, and compare the two.
evals.expected_output: Plan both workspaces with identical arguments, save one prediction in both, lock the baseline workspace with taste_profile baseline true before either arm is built, build both arms, then design_compare and report the limits.
expectations: Uses the workspaces compare/with-qloo and compare/without-qloo
Saves the identical prediction artifact in both workspaces before any measurement
Calls taste_profile with baseline true for compare/without-qloo before building either arm
Builds the baseline arm before measuring, when the arms run in one session
Calls design_compare with both workspaces and reports samePrediction and the surprise headline
States that one pair is one sample and that the distance does not measure quality
